segments.title: Two hash functions
segments.note: First hash = home slot, second hash = step size. The step can never be 0.

segments.title: Collisions and different steps
segments.note: Wraparound with mod, and two keys with the same home slot taking different paths. That fixes secondary clustering.

segments.title: Why table size matters
segments.note: Step and table size must share no factor (relatively prime). 10 slots with step 5 only ever visits 0 and 5.
segments.check: Write the probe sequence for k = 22 with m = 10, h1(k) = sum of digits, h2(k) = k squared, for i = 0..3. Why can't it reach every slot?

segments.title: Max-heaps: shape, property, insert, delete
segments.note: Shows both the tree picture and the array form. Delete = move last leaf to root, sift down, O(log n).
segments.check: 1) Remove the max from the heap 10, 9, 7, 1, 3, 5 and write the array after each swap. 2) In a 1-based array, what are the indices of the parent and children of node i? 3) What is the height of a heap with n nodes?
